results.title: English | Ootoya
results.content:
We grill fish and meat over charcoal, known for its high heat efficiency. Enjoy the rich flavor and aroma that comes from slow grilling over charcoal.

 

### Fresh panko

Ootoya’s cutlets are made with fresh panko breadcrumbs. Once you place your order, we carefully coat the cutlets with fresh panko and fry them slowly at a low temperature. The fresh panko locks in flavor and moisture while creating a perfectly crisp, golden exterior.

 

### Grated daikon radish [...] Chicken cutlet simmered in a special sauce that has been popular with diners for as long as we have been in business. Nameko mushrooms and grated daikon radish add the finishing touch.

 

### Ootoya Tuna & Healthy Sticky Bowl

A bowl of rice topped with natto, okra, mekabu seaweed, grated yam, tuna, egg yolk, and other ingredients, served with premium Honkarebushi bonito flakes.

 

### Ootoya-Style Nanban Chicken [...] ### Miso soup

We adjust the flavor of our set meal miso soup according to the season by carefully selecting miso from different regions of Japan. Savor our set meals even more with seasonal miso soup.

 

### Rice

We go the extra mile to source only the finest rice, ensuring that we choose brands that are suited to local palates. The result is freshly cooked, fluffy rice that complements the flavor of our meals.
